questions.korean: 그는 아무 말도 없이 그냥 자리를 떠났어.
answers: He just up and left without saying a word.
He walked out without so much as a goodbye.
questions.hint: just up and left = 갑자기 그냥 가버리다, without so much as = ~조차 없이
questions.explanation: without so much as = 심지어 ~도 없이

questions.korean: 그 시험이 그에게는 식은 죽 먹기였어.
answers: That exam was a walk in the park for him.
The test was a breeze for him.
questions.hint: walk in the park / a breeze = 식은 죽 먹기

questions.korean: 나는 이미 그가 올 거라는 걸 알고 있었어.
answers: I could see it coming.
I had a feeling he was going to show up.
questions.hint: could see it coming = 미리 알 수 있었다

questions.korean: 그는 언제 그쳐야 할지를 알아.
answers: He knows when to quit while he's ahead.
He has the wisdom to stop while he's still on top.
questions.hint: quit while you're ahead = 여유 있을 때 멈추다
questions.explanation: quit while you're ahead = 지고 있지 않을 때 그만두다

questions.korean: 그 말이 마음에 걸려.
answers: That comment is still nagging at me.
Those words are still ringing in my head.
questions.hint: nagging at me / ringing in my head = 마음에 걸리다

questions.korean: 그 소식을 듣고 기뻐야 할지 슬퍼야 할지 모르겠어.
answers: I don't know whether to laugh or cry about the news.
The news left me not knowing how to feel.
questions.hint: don't know whether to laugh or cry = 웃어야 할지 울어야 할지

questions.korean: 그건 내 마음속에서 뭔가를 건드렸어.
answers: It struck a chord with me.
That touched something deep inside me.
questions.hint: strike a chord / touch something deep = 마음속의 뭔가를 건드리다

questions.korean: 나는 그에 대해 애증의 감정이 있어.
answers: I have a love-hate relationship with it.
My feelings toward him are complicated.
questions.hint: love-hate relationship = 애증의 감계

questions.korean: 그 말이 오랫동안 내 머릿속을 맴돌았어.
answers: Those words kept echoing in my mind for a long time.
That stayed with me for a long time.
questions.hint: keep echoing / stay with me = 머릿속에 남다

questions.korean: 이 상황에서 벗어나고 싶지만, 동시에 그게 두렵기도 해.
answers: I want to break free from this situation, yet I'm also afraid to.
As much as I want out, the thought of leaving is terrifying.
questions.hint: break free from / want out = 벗어나고 싶다

questions.korean: 이 주장을 뒷받침하는 세 가지 핵심 근거가 있어.
answers: There are three key pieces of evidence to support this argument.
Three compelling reasons back up this claim.
questions.hint: key pieces of evidence / compelling reasons = 핵심 근거

questions.korean: 반론을 제기하는 사람들도 있겠지만, 증거는 명확해.
answers: Some may argue otherwise, but the evidence is clear.
While counterarguments exist, the data speaks for itself.
questions.hint: some may argue otherwise / data speaks for itself = 반론이 있지만 증거가 명확하다
questions.explanation: the data speaks for itself = 데이터가 스스로 말한다

questions.korean: 그 점을 고려해볼 때, 결론은 자명해.
answers: Taking that into consideration, the conclusion is self-evident.
Given that, the conclusion practically draws itself.
questions.hint: self-evident / draws itself = 자명한
questions.explanation: self-evident = 증명이 필요 없을 만큼 명백한

questions.korean: 이것은 단순히 의견의 문제가 아니라 사실의 문제야.
answers: This isn't merely a matter of opinion; it's a question of fact.
We're not talking about perspectives here — this is about facts.
questions.hint: not merely a matter of opinion / question of fact = 의견이 아닌 사실의 문제

questions.korean: 그러므로, 우리는 즉각적인 조치를 취해야 한다는 결론에 이르게 돼.
answers: Therefore, we are led to the conclusion that immediate action is necessary.
It follows, then, that we must act without delay.
questions.hint: therefore / it follows that = 그러므로, 따라서

questions.korean: 모든 일이 잘못될 수 있는 날이 있어. 그날이 그런 날이었어.
answers: There are days when everything that can go wrong will. That was one of those days.
Some days nothing goes right. That was definitely one of them.
questions.hint: when everything that can go wrong will = 머피의 법칙
questions.explanation: Murphy's Law = 잘못될 수 있는 건 다 잘못된다

questions.korean: 그 순간이 모든 것을 바꿨어.
answers: That was the moment everything changed.
In that instant, everything shifted.
questions.hint: the moment everything changed / in that instant = 그 순간

questions.korean: 이야기의 교훈은 간단해 - 인내가 성공의 열쇠야.
answers: The lesson of the story is simple — perseverance is the key to success.
What the story teaches us is this: persistence pays off.
questions.hint: the lesson of the story / what the story teaches = 이야기의 교훈
questions.explanation: persistence pays off = 끈기가 결실을 맺는다

questions.korean: 그는 고난을 딛고 일어선 사람이야.
answers: He is someone who rose above adversity.
He overcame every obstacle that stood in his way.
questions.hint: rise above adversity / overcome every obstacle = 고난을 딛고 일어서다

questions.korean: 그 이야기의 반전은 아무도 예상 못 했어.
answers: The twist in the story caught everyone off guard.
Nobody saw the plot twist coming.
questions.hint: caught everyone off guard / no one saw it coming = 아무도 예상 못 했다
questions.explanation: catch off guard = 방심한 틈을 찌르다

questions.korean: 그 시장은 전반적으로 하락세야.
answers: The market is in a general downtrend.
The market has been trending downward across the board.
questions.hint: downtrend / trending downward across the board = 전반적 하락세

questions.korean: 우리는 비용을 줄이면서 효율을 높여야 해.
answers: We need to cut costs while increasing efficiency.
The goal is to do more with less.
questions.hint: cut costs / do more with less = 비용을 줄이다, 적은 것으로 더 많이 하다

questions.korean: 그 투자는 장기적으로 봐야 해.
answers: That investment needs to be viewed with a long-term perspective.
You have to take the long view on that investment.
questions.hint: long-term perspective / take the long view = 장기적으로 보다

questions.korean: 그 회사는 재정적으로 어려운 상황에 처해 있어.
answers: The company is in financial distress.
The company is struggling financially.
questions.hint: financial distress / struggling financially = 재정 어려움

questions.korean: 그것은 수익성이 높은 틈새 시장이야.
answers: It's a highly profitable niche market.
That's a lucrative niche with a lot of potential.
questions.hint: profitable niche / lucrative = 수익성이 높은 틈새 시장

questions.korean: 그는 인정받고 싶은 욕구가 강해.
answers: He has a strong need for validation.
He craves recognition.
questions.hint: need for validation / craves recognition = 인정 욕구

questions.korean: 그녀는 자기 파괴적인 행동을 하고 있어.
answers: She's engaging in self-destructive behavior.
She's sabotaging herself.
questions.hint: self-destructive / sabotaging herself = 자기 파괴적

questions.korean: 그는 그 사실을 직면하기를 회피하고 있어.
answers: He's avoiding confronting the reality.
He's in denial about the facts.
questions.hint: avoiding confronting / in denial = 직면 회피, 부정

questions.korean: 그 경험이 그녀의 세계관을 형성했어.
answers: That experience shaped her worldview.
That shaped how she sees the world.
questions.hint: shaped her worldview / shaped how she sees = 세계관을 형성하다

questions.korean: 그는 외부의 인정보다 내적 동기가 더 강해.
answers: His internal motivation outweighs external validation.
He's driven more by intrinsic motivation than outside recognition.
questions.hint: intrinsic motivation / internal motivation = 내적 동기

questions.korean: 우리는 탄소 발자국을 줄여야 해.
answers: We need to reduce our carbon footprint.
We must lower our environmental impact.
questions.hint: carbon footprint / environmental impact = 탄소 발자국, 환경 영향

questions.korean: 지속 가능한 개발이 미래를 위한 유일한 길이야.
answers: Sustainable development is the only viable path forward.
A sustainable approach is the only way to secure our future.
questions.hint: sustainable development / viable path = 지속 가능한 개발

questions.korean: 그 기업은 환경 친화적인 관행을 채택했어.
answers: The company has adopted eco-friendly practices.
They've embraced environmentally sustainable operations.
questions.hint: eco-friendly / environmentally sustainable = 환경 친화적

questions.korean: 기후 변화의 영향은 이미 우리 삶 곳곳에 미치고 있어.
answers: The effects of climate change are already making themselves felt in every aspect of our lives.
Climate change is already touching every part of our daily lives.
questions.hint: effects of climate change / making themselves felt = 영향이 느껴지다

questions.korean: 우리는 미래 세대를 위해 지구를 보존할 책임이 있어.
answers: We have a responsibility to preserve the Earth for future generations.
It's our duty to protect the planet for those who come after us.
questions.hint: responsibility to preserve / duty to protect = 보존/보호할 책임

questions.korean: 그는 어려운 환경 속에서도 성공한 자수성가형 인물이야.
answers: He's a self-made man who succeeded against all odds.
He pulled himself up by his bootstraps.
questions.hint: self-made / pulled himself up by his bootstraps = 자수성가
questions.explanation: pull oneself up by the bootstraps = 자력으로 일어서다
keywords: pulled himself up by his bootstraps

questions.korean: 그건 미국의 꿈을 상징해.
answers: It embodies the American Dream.
That symbolizes everything the American Dream stands for.
questions.hint: embodies / symbolizes the American Dream = 미국의 꿈을 상징하다

questions.korean: 그는 아이비리그 출신이야.
answers: He went to an Ivy League school.
He's an Ivy League graduate.
questions.hint: Ivy League school / graduate = 아이비리그 학교
questions.explanation: Ivy League = Harvard, Yale, Princeton 등 명문대

questions.korean: 그들은 결국 합의에 도달했어. 전형적인 미국식 협상이지.
answers: They eventually struck a deal — classic American-style negotiation.
They reached a compromise in true American fashion.
questions.hint: struck a deal / reached a compromise = 합의하다, 타협하다

questions.korean: 그는 책임을 회피하려 하고 있어.
answers: He's trying to pass the buck.
He's dodging accountability.
questions.hint: pass the buck / dodge accountability = 책임을 전가하다
questions.explanation: pass the buck = 책임을 남에게 떠넘기다

questions.korean: 그 도시는 현대와 전통이 공존하는 독특한 곳이야.
answers: The city is a unique place where modernity and tradition coexist.
It's a city where the old and the new exist in fascinating harmony.
questions.hint: coexist / exist in harmony = 공존하다

questions.korean: 그 분위기는 말로 표현하기 어려웠어.
answers: The atmosphere was hard to put into words.
It was an ambiance that defied description.
questions.hint: hard to put into words / defied description = 말로 표현하기 어려운

questions.korean: 그 경험은 내 인생에서 두 번 다시 없을 순간이었어.
answers: It was a once-in-a-lifetime experience.
That moment was truly one of a kind.
questions.hint: once-in-a-lifetime / one of a kind = 다시 없을 순간

questions.korean: 그것은 우리가 알던 세상의 모든 것을 바꿔 놓았어.
answers: It changed everything we thought we knew about the world.
It turned our entire understanding of the world on its head.
questions.hint: changed everything / turned on its head = 완전히 뒤바꿔 놓다
questions.explanation: turn something on its head = 완전히 뒤집다

questions.korean: 그들은 세월의 시험을 견뎌낸 우정을 쌓았어.
answers: They built a friendship that has stood the test of time.
Their bond has proven resilient across the years.
questions.hint: stood the test of time / proven resilient = 세월을 이겨내다
questions.explanation: stand the test of time = 시간이 지나도 변하지 않다

questions.korean: 단순히 일어난 일을 돌아보는 것이 아니라, 우리는 그것으로부터 배워야 해.
answers: Rather than simply looking back at what happened, we need to learn from it.
Instead of dwelling on the past, we should draw lessons from it.
questions.hint: rather than simply / instead of dwelling = ~하는 대신, 단순히 ~이 아니라
questions.explanation: dwell on = ~에 집착하다, draw lessons from = ~에서 교훈을 얻다

questions.korean: 아이러니하게도, 가장 간단한 해결책이 종종 가장 간과되는 법이야.
answers: Ironically, the simplest solutions are often the most overlooked.
As a rule, the most obvious fix tends to be the last thing people consider.
questions.hint: ironically / as a rule = 아이러니하게도, 일반적으로

questions.korean: 어떤 장애물이 앞을 가로막더라도, 포기는 선택지가 아니야.
answers: Whatever obstacles stand in the way, giving up is not an option.
No matter what challenges arise, quitting is never on the table.
questions.hint: whatever obstacles / no matter what = 어떤 장애물이든, giving up is not an option = 포기는 선택지가 아니다
keywords: giving up is not an option
quitting is never on the table

questions.korean: 그 복잡성과 모순 속에서도, 진실의 핵심은 찾을 수 있어.
answers: Even amid the complexity and contradictions, the core truth can be found.
Despite the nuance and ambiguity, there is a fundamental truth at the heart of it.
questions.hint: amid the complexity / at the heart of it = ~의 한가운데에서, 핵심에는

questions.korean: 결국, 우리가 남기는 유산은 우리가 어떻게 살았는지에 달려 있어.
answers: In the end, the legacy we leave behind depends on how we lived.
What we leave behind is a reflection of how we chose to live.
questions.hint: legacy we leave behind / reflection of how we lived = 유산, 사는 방식의 반영
